tools.name: fetch_questionnaire
tools.description: Fetch a FHIR Questionnaire resource from a payer's DTR endpoint URL. Returns the full Questionnaire resource for rendering in the PA workflow.

questionnaire_url.description: The full URL of the payer's FHIR Questionnaire endpoint

tools.name: eval_expressions
tools.description: Evaluate initialExpression and calculatedExpression extensions in a FHIR Questionnaire against patient data from HealthLake. Returns auto-fill results with linkId, source resource ID, and resolved value for each item with an expression.

questionnaire.description: The FHIR Questionnaire resource to evaluate expressions for

patient_id.description: The patient's FHIR ID to resolve expressions against

tools.name: get_dtr_config
tools.description: Look up DTR Questionnaire configuration for a given payer and procedure code. Returns the questionnaire URL and metadata if a DTR questionnaire is configured for the payer/procedure combination.

payer_name.description: The name of the insurance payer (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'UnitedHealthcare')

procedure_code.description: The CPT or HCPCS procedure code (e.g., '72148')
